ASSIGNMENT OFEXCESS DEVELOPMENT RIGHTS(121) Hamilton Lofts LLC ("Assignor"), a New York limited liability company, to Gold 48 LLC ("Assignee"), a New York limited liability company, both having an office of 448 GreenwichStreet,#4,NewYork,NY10013; WHEREAS, Assignor was the Sponsor of a condominium offering plan known as The 121 Edgecombe Avenue Condominium located at 121 Edgecombe Avenue,Borough of Manhattan,NewYork County,City and State of NewYork,in accordance with the declaration ("Declaration") establishing a plan for condominium ownership of said premises underArticle 9-B of theReal Property Law of theState of NewYork,dated October 16, 2009, and recorded in the New York County office of the Register of The City of NewYork on November 5,2009 as CRFN 2009000362369; WHEREAS,inaccordancewithArticle30oftheDeclaration,Assignorretained the Excess Development Rights (as defined in the Declaration); WHEREAS, Assignor desires to assign to Assignee all of Assignor's right, title and interest in and to theExcessDevelopment Rights; NOW,THEREFORE,for ten dollars and for good and other valuable consideration, Assignor assigns of its right, title and interest in and to the Excess Development Rights.
